product.name: Stone & Beam Modern Rustic Round Wood and Galvanized Metal Wall Shelf Decor, 24 Inch (Renewed)
product.description: Wooden shelves surrounded by a round galvanized metal frame bring together rustic and industrial touches. This piece doubles as eye-catching wall art while holding spices in a kitchen or treasured objects in a living room or hallway. 6"D x 24"W x 24"H Fir wood, galvanized metal Ready to hang, all hardware included
